markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 两个比，用**比较级**：faster than；三个以上挑「最」，用**最高级**：the fastest。短的词加 -er / -est，长的词前面加 more / most。

uses.en: The new build is [[fast{er}]] <<than>> the old one.
This is [[the slow{est}]] screen in the app.
uses.en_zh: 这是 App 里最慢的一个页面。

uses.en: The Android app is [[as fast as]] the iOS one.
uses.en_zh: 安卓版和 iOS 版一样快。

spelling.title: 怎么变
spelling.rule: 看词的长短：只有一个音的短词（fast、big）加 -er / -est；y 结尾的 easy、busy 也这样变；其他长词前面加 more / most。

rules.ending: 一个元音 + 一个辅音结尾

comparative.title: 比较级：两个比
comparative.rule: 两个东西比，比较级后面用 than 带出被比的那一个。than 后面只有一个人时，口语说 me、him。

examples.en: This flat is [[more expensive]] <<than>> the last one.

notes: Tom is taller than [[me]].（口语）= Tom is taller than [[I am]].（完整说法）

superlative.title: 最高级：挑「最」
superlative.rule: 三个以上挑「最」，前面加 the。后面说「在哪个地方、哪个团队里」用 in；说「在一群里」用 of。

examples.zh: 她是我们组最好的开发者。

examples.en: It was [[the most useful]] talk <<of>> the day.
examples.zh: 那是当天最有用的一场演讲。

examples.en: That's [[the best]] film I've ever seen.
examples.zh: 那是我看过的最好的电影。

as-as.title: 一样，或者不如
as-as.rule: 两边一样，用 **as + 原来的词 + as**，中间的词不变。说「不如」，用 **not as … as**，比用 less 更自然。

examples.en: The Android app is [[as fast as]] the iOS one.
examples.zh: 安卓版和 iOS 版一样快。

examples.en: The second meeting wasn't [[as long as]] the first.
examples.zh: 第二个会没有第一个长。

examples.en: Our new office is [[twice as big as]] the old one.
examples.zh: 我们的新办公室是旧的两倍大。

wrong.bad: It's as ~~faster~~ as the old one.
wrong.good: It's [[as fast as]] the old one.

degree.title: 差多少，越来越
degree.rule: 比较级前面加词，说差多少：much、a lot、far = 多得多；a bit、slightly = 稍微。**不能用 very**。

items.en: Could you make the font [[a bit big{ger}]]?
items.zh: 能把字体稍微调大一点吗？

items.rule: 越……越……：the + 比较级, the + 比较级
items.en: [[The soon{er}]] we start, [[the soon{er}]] we finish.
items.zh: 我们开始得越早，结束得越早。

items.rule: 越来越……：比较级 and 比较级
items.en: The app is getting [[slow{er} and slow{er}]].
items.zh: 这个 App 越来越慢了。

items.rule: 长词越来越：more and more + 词
items.en: Swift is getting [[more and more popular]].

this.en: This plan is [[better]] than that one.

that.en: This plan is [[the best]] of the three.

commonMistakes.bad: It's ~~more cheap~~ than the old one.

commonMistakes.why: better 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。
比较级前面用 much，不用 very。
比较用 than，then 是「然后」。

quiz.prompt: Of the three designs, this one is ___.
quiz.explain: 三个里挑「最」，用最高级：[[the best]]。

traps.note: 一个元音 + 一个辅音结尾，要双写 g。

quiz.explain: 辅音 + y：去 y 加 iest，[[the eas{iest}]]。

quiz.prompt: The new build is ___ (fast) than the old one.
改错：This flat is more cheap than the last one.
quiz.answer: This flat is cheaper than the last one.

quiz.prompt: It's the slowest screen ___ the app.
quiz.explain: 「在 App 里」是一个范围，用 [[in]]。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：这是我看过的最好的电影。
quiz.answer: This is the best film I've ever seen.
accept: This is the best film I have ever seen.
It's the best film I've ever seen.
It's the best film I have ever seen.
This is the best movie I've ever seen.
That's the best film I've ever seen.
That is the best film I've ever seen.

quiz.prompt: 用 not as … as 改写：The first meeting was longer than the second.
quiz.answer: The second meeting wasn't as long as the first.
accept: The second meeting was not as long as the first.
The second meeting wasn't as long as the first one.
The second meeting was not as long as the first one.

traps.input: The second meeting wasn't as longer as the first.
traps.note: as … as 中间用原来的词 long。

quiz.prompt: The Android app is as ___ (fast) as the iOS one.

traps.note: as … as 中间的词不变。

quiz.explain: as … as 中间用原来的词：[[as fast as]]。
比较级前面说「多得多」用 [[much]]，不用 very。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我们开始得越早，结束得越早。
quiz.answer: The sooner we start, the sooner we finish.
accept: The earlier we start, the earlier we finish.
The sooner we start, the earlier we finish.
The earlier we start, the sooner we finish.

quiz.prompt: The app is getting ___ (slow) every week.（越来越慢）
quiz.explain: 越来越：比较级 and 比较级，[[slow{er} and slow{er}]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：This version is more better than the last one.
quiz.answer: This version is better than the last one.
quiz.explain: better 已经是比较级，去掉 more。

traps.note: then 是「然后」，比较用 than。

openTask.prompt: 比一比你用过的两个工具、两部手机或两个城市，说 3 句话：一句比较级，一句最高级，一句 as … as 或 not as … as。
rules: 两者比较用比较级 + than
三者以上用 the + 最高级
as … as 中间用形容词原级；比较级前不用 very
openTask.note: 规则判比较级、最高级形式（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
